title: EPIC-HAR: code and results for 'Holding Out the Person and the Phone: Budgeted Activity Recognition and a Factorial Study of What Each Component Contributes'
description: Code, logged results (822 baseline-grid runs, 594 component-study runs). Includes the EPIC-HAR framework notebook, the LOSDO protocol, the 2^(5-1) factorial component study and a two-GPU Kaggle runner. Datasets (HHAR, LMDHG) are not redistributed.
